summary: First Real Estate Investment Trust of New Jersey filed an 8-K reporting that stockholders approved a Plan of Voluntary Liquidation at a September 29, 2026 special meeting, with 5,085,293 votes for versus 6,503 against. The plan provides for winding up, asset sales or transfer to a liquidating trust, and dissolution. On September 30, 2026, the Trust declared an initial liquidating distribution of $3.20 per share, payable October 29, 2026 to holders of record October 14, 2026. Watch execution of asset sales, additional distributions, and dissolution timing.
